_about.method: Each PDF read twice: pdftotext -layout and a 110 dpi render (price columns re-checked at 200 dpi). Most dish names on the A la carte pages are outlined artwork with no text layer, so the image is the source for names, codes and prices. Where the two disagreed, the image was used.

fields.name: dish name exactly as printed, typos kept
fields.tagline: label printed next to the name, typos kept
fields.desc: description exactly as printed, typos kept, line breaks joined
fields.price: price exactly as printed (euro, dot decimal)
fields.codes: small superscript allergen or additive codes printed next to the name; their key is not on any supplied page
fields.labels: coloured labels on the page (Veggie, VEGAN, vegetarisch, Neu)
fields.chilis: number of chili icons printed next to the dish

text.headline: Freiburgs ältestes indisches Restaurant
paragraphs: Namaste und herzlich willkommen im Jaipur! Seit über drei Jahrzehnten verwöhnen wir unsere Gäste mit der Vielfalt der traditionellen indischen Küche. Mit der frischen Zutaten, authentischen Rezepten und aromatischen Gewürzen bereiten wir jedes Gericht mit Leidenschaft zu.
Ob würzige Currys, duftender Biryani oder frisch gebackenes Naan aus dem Tandoor-Ofen – erleben Sie den echten Geschmack Indiens.
Wir wünschen Ihnen einen angenehmen Aufenthalt und guten Appetit.

Names, taglines and description wording: identical.

Typesetting only: descriptions of Lamm Tikka, Mixed-Grill-Teller, Jaipur Prawn Tikka and Seekh Kebab were set in a condensed bold face in the old file and match the other dishes in the new file; Garlic-Mint Tikka was re-indented.
